order: SERVICE FAILURE: at least one learned guarantee evaluation of the (profile, method) fails with an open counter wait -> the J comparison is not interpreted as a success; counts and Clopper-Pearson intervals reported

NOT ESTIMABLE: any other learned failure, or a comparator failure on a traffic (J undefined; never imputed); a descriptive sensitivity without the failing model or traffic is reported, never used for the decision
decision_rules.interval: [L, U] = 99.5 % crossed-bootstrap interval of mean D (learned minus comparator; negative = learned better)
claims_allowed: per profile and method only; no pooling across profiles for a decision

idqn_exclusion.decision: IDQN is not part of the confirmation (decided before any confirmation traffic exists)
reasons: question: the confirmation tests the cooperative value-factorisation methods (QMIX, VDN) with the guarantee alone; IDQN (independent learners, no coordination) is the non-cooperative reference of the development, ablation and robustness studies, where it is reported in full

known instability before confirmation: in the ablation IDQN is the only method whose minimum-green effect is irregular (improves some models, degrades others; corrects 4 failures, creates 1) and it has 4/50 failures without protection (Clopper-Pearson 95 % [2.2 %, 19.2 %]); in the robustness study (reported) the guarantee alone raises D_bar in 35 IDQN pairs and the 107/8203 diagnosis shows long opposite greens after interventions: IDQN with the guarantee is not a stable candidate whose result a confirmation could corroborate
multiplicity: adding IDQN would raise the primary family from 10 to 15 comparisons (Bonferroni 99.67 %) and widen every decision interval for a configuration that is not a candidate
consequences: no confirmation claim of any kind about IDQN
its development, ablation and robustness results are kept and reported in full
declared limitation: the methods confirmed were chosen after the development and robustness results; the confirmation tests them on new traffics, it does not compare all methods
